scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts Poaceae species rank, combination Novon 11:368 (2001); WFO corroborates. Existing canonical binomial correct; no renaming.
POWO/WCVP accepts separate Poaceae species rank, combination Flora of Tropical Africa 9:601 (1920); WFO corroborates. No renaming.
POWO/WCVP accepts separate Poaceae species rank, Australian Paniceae:253 (1987); WFO corroborates. No renaming.
POWO lists original 1788 name as homotypic synonym; the fuscum epithet is the basionym of the current combination.
POWO lists Swartz's 1788 Panicum name as heterotypic synonym of U. fusca; preserve author because Lam.'s later Panicum fasciculatum is a different taxonomic concept.
POWO lists the 1969 Brachiaria combination as heterotypic synonym; historical GrassBase treated it as accepted, but current POWO does not.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Urochloa fasciculata (Sw.) R.D.Webster ex Morrone & Zuloaga
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO maps 1992 combination to U. fusca and explicitly marks it illegitimate later homonym; retain author and illegitimacy.
POWO maps Kunth's earlier 1829 combination to separately accepted Alloteropsis cimicina, NOT U. fusca. This is the earlier homonym responsible for the later-name conflict.
POWO lists Lam.'s 1798 Panicum name as an illegitimate later homonym under accepted Alloteropsis cimicina, not U. fusca. Do not conflate with P. fasciculatum Sw.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Assertion: every historical Urochloa fasciculata or Panicum fasciculatum record maps to Urochloa fusca
scientific_decisions.reason: Blanket mapping fails: the Swartz-derived Urochloa/Panicum concepts map to U. fusca, whereas Kunth's earlier Urochloa fasciculata and Lamarck's Panicum fasciculatum map to Alloteropsis cimicina. FAIL applies to the assertion, not the accepted learner names.

POWO lists 1759 basionym as homotypic synonym of U. reptans.
POWO lists 1938 Brachiaria combination as homotypic synonym of U. reptans; not U. fusca or U. texana.

Existing species has recorded source-labelled reproductive images but same-plant collar and rooted base plus matched congener comparison remain gaps; no automatic specimen ID PASS.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry or introgression of individual Urochloa fusca, U. reptans and U. texana learner specimens
scientific_decisions.reason: No specimen-level molecular, voucher or diagnostic evidence was reviewed establishing hybrid parentage. Do not infer a hybrid from similarity, and do not bypass any existing hybrid/identity hold.

cross_species_boundary_warning: Urochloa fasciculata (Sw.) R.D.Webster ex Morrone & Zuloaga (1992) is an illegitimate later homonym mapping to U. fusca; Urochloa fasciculata (Roem. & Schult.) Kunth (1829) maps to Alloteropsis cimicina. Panicum fasciculatum Sw. and Panicum fasciculatum Lam. likewise map to different accepted taxa. Require author, rank and specimen before reconciling old records.
followup: Keep all three existing Urochloa species cards unchanged. Preserve original labels and specimen-ID/hybrid holds; only reassign historical fasciculata observations after original author/voucher verification. No new species or genus cards from this taxonomy evidence.
